findings: FREE SPINS (100x buy) advertises MAX WIN 10,000x in the rules table and on the splash badge, but the shipped maths caps that mode at 5,000x: library/configs/config_fe_wild_wanted.json:41 says "max_win": 5000 and the maximum payout across all 200,000 rows of library/publish_files/lookUpTable_bonus_0.csv is 5,000x, against 10,000x in every other mode's table. Source of the wrong figure: web-sdk/apps/wild-wanted/src/game/config.ts:177, rendered via MenuModal.svelte:266 and :498-505, Math.max'd into the splash badge at IntroScreen.svelte:755, and repeated on the buy card and confirm dialog via packages/state-shared/src/constants.ts:295,338 (mode: 'bonus' ... maxWin: 10000) - so the wrong ceiling is shown at the point of purchase. MenuModal.svelte:249-251 states the correct 5,000x exception in a comment. tools/verify_maxwin_sync.mjs:30-36 cannot catch it: it compares state-shared/constants.ts to game/config.ts and never reads the maths pack. Checklist 47/48/101; defect C6; lessons round 6.3.

Displayed RTP is 96.0% on all six rows of the rules table (config.ts:30,141,148,155,176,194,205 rtp: 0.96; MenuModal.svelte:283); the published pack is 96.5% - config_fe_wild_wanted.json carries "rtp": 0.965 seven times, and recomputing sum(weight x payout)/totalWeight/cost over every published lookUpTable_*_0.csv gives 0.965000 in all six modes. Checklist 101.

52 of 53 audio cues are Mummy's Riches' Ancient Egypt pack, unchanged. Sprite regions are name/offset/length identical to mummysriches/web-sdk/apps/mummy-madness/build/assets/audio/sounds.json for 52 cues (only bgm_burst is new). Decoded PCM difference to Mummy's is 0.054-0.33 (re-encode noise) versus 0.99-2.51 against a genuinely different pack. sounds.json's own source map declares "Ancient Egypt", "MUMMY FEATURE MUSIC", "EGYPT WIN TUNE" x9, "ANCIENT EGYPT SPECIAL REEL STOP" x5 and "MUMMY VOICE - Angry Roar Attack" x5; zero cues are Western-sourced. soundCatalogue.ts:101-104 admits it. The studio's own gate returns "audit_audio_origin: FAIL - worst BLOCKER" and is not wired into build:stake (grep -c audit_audio_origin package.json = 0). CLAUDE.md:183 lists DONOR AUDIO as a standing blocker. Not silence: every cue has real amplitude (peak 0.24-1.05) and all 53 are reached from source.

The artefact committed at 287fca0 and deployed by vercel.json is a preview build carrying a mock RGS. Console at boot: "[rgsMock] installed - PREVIEW"; wallet is a $100,000 literal (hooks.client.ts:39). Bundle greps positive for __WW_AUDIT__, devMockAuth, previewBooks, showcase, antreel, bossgold, "preview mock" and "COPY SFS (all layouts)"; ?debug=1 renders a 60-control POSITION DEBUG authoring panel over the game. tools/verify_stake_clean.mjs:71 greps for exactly these tokens and exits 1, so the studio's own clean gate would reject it; tools/zip_stake_upload.mjs:51-53 confirms the preview build is committed deliberately. No production artefact and no dist/ zip exist in the repo. Checklist 88/89, trap T17.

The application bundle ships twice. index.html is 6,820,548 bytes and its inline script from offset 89,619 is byte-identical to _app/immutable/bundle.BZqrh6NY.js (6,730,680 bytes), which is never requested - a full boot issues 263 unique requests, none under _app/. vercel.json marks /index.html no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate, so 6.7 MB of JavaScript is re-downloaded on every load and every mid-round refresh, and a further 6.7 MB is dead weight in a 54 MB upload. Fifteen assets/wwfont/*.webp glyphs are also each requested three times per boot.

Two live assets are byte-identical to the web-sdk lines sample game: assets/spines/anticipation/anticipation.atlas (md5 a76d3375e4e7a05731edf3d4ba4e6fa2) and anticipation.json (md5 d16c92a94ef846724ae2e69c87a3d50c), 345 KB of skeleton data, both requested at boot. Checklist 84 / T15. Only 22 of 417 shipped assets match Mummy's Riches, all shared studio chrome - the art overhaul is otherwise genuine.

The FREE SPINS shoot-to-wild mechanic is rendered but absent from the rules. Implemented at src/game/shootWildsBeat.ts:15-25 (aim, muzzle flash, frame jolt, blast sheet, wild revealed), wired through ShotBlasts.svelte:90 and bookEventHandlerMap.ts:54, and advertised on the intro splash as "The outlaw shoots symbols and turns them wild". grep -n shoot MenuModal.svelte returns only lines 551 and 561, both about BURST BONUS crates; the rendered FREE SPINS rules section covers spin counts and retriggers only. Checklist 53 / T12 / defect C16.

At Popout S (400x225) the primary spin control is clipped 8 px below the viewport: a Pixi bounds walk over nodes with eventMode==='static' && cursor==='pointer' returns it at y=174, h=59, bottom edge 233. Same node at 480x270 (bottom 280) and 844x390 (bottom 403). Its centre stays inside so it remains clickable, and the rest of the compact layout is a genuine re-stack that is playable. Checklist 69 / T13.

Nits: unminified CSS with internal developer commentary ships in index.html (including the phrase "The donor game's 'ZombieMummy2' bandage face"); three capitalised basenames in the artefact (bundle.BZqrh6NY.js, style.CLtj3ii3.css, style.eu72C58p.css) against T10's filename law, all unreferenced; the disclaimer's trademark line reads "TM and (c) 2026 Engine." where Stake's template says "Stake Engine" (MenuModal.svelte:1021).
lift: Set config.ts bonus.max_win to 5000 and rtp to 0.965 across all six modes so the rules table matches config_fe_wild_wanted.json and the published lookup tables, and rewrite tools/verify_maxwin_sync.mjs to read the maths pack as a third input instead of comparing two front-end files to each other. That takes the game out of the displayed-does-not-equal-actual category, which is the only thing on my list I treat as disqualifying rather than merely expensive.
